newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian dies after quake destroys house.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian dies after quake destroys house.

text.p: An elderly Egyptian woman died on Wednesday after a powerful tremor destroyed her one-storey house in the Delta province of Gharbiya, security sources said.
They said Adeela Rabea al-Gaafari died in Faheem village, near the town of Santa. No other casualties have been reported but the tremor is said to have caused cracks in several old buildings.
The earthquake hit Egypt at about 3.15 pm (1315 GMT) and measured about six on the Richter scale, state-run television said. It was also felt in Cyprus, Israel, Lebanon, Syria and Turkey.
Six people died, including two who jumped out of buildings in panic, and 10 others were hurt after an earthquake hit Egypt last year.
More than 500 people died and hundreds were hurt and left homeless when a strong earthquake hit Egypt on October 12, 1992. Most injuries occurred when badly constructed buildings collapsed.
